quote: Wherever you are, be all there.
intention: Do one ordinary thing today with your whole attention: a cup of tea, a walk, a conversation.

quote: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
intention: Notice the moment you want to shrink today. Take one breath, and expand instead.

quote: Be still, and know that I am God.
intention: Give the first quiet minute of your day to something larger than you.

quote: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
intention: Stop waiting for perfect conditions. Start with the small thing in front of you.

quote: Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom.
intention: When you react strongly today, ask quietly: what in me is this?

quote: Do you have the patience to wait until your mud settles and the water is clear?
intention: Don't decide anything important while the water is muddy. Breathe first.

quote: You have the right to work, but never to the fruit of work.
intention: Do your part fully today, then let the outcome go. It was never yours to hold.

quote: Hatred does not cease by hatred, but only by love; this is the eternal rule.
intention: Meet one sharp moment today with softness. It costs less than you think.

quote: This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
intention: Name three small things you're glad for before you check your phone.

quote: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
intention: Show up for the practice today, even if it's only five minutes. The habit is the point.

quote: Feelings come and go like clouds in a windy sky. Conscious breathing is my anchor.
intention: When a strong feeling arrives, don't argue with it. Breathe with it until it moves on.

quote: I learned that courage was not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it.
intention: Fear is very good at predicting the future, and very bad at being right. Go anyway.

quote: Lead me from the unreal to the real, from darkness to light.
intention: Offer your work today as a prayer, whatever the work is.

quote: Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
intention: Pick one goal for today and give it your best hour.

quote: Hope is something you give yourself. That is the meaning of inner strength.
by: Uncle Iroh, Avatar: The Last Airbender
intention: Give yourself a little hope today. You're allowed to.

quote: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
intention: Move one step slower than usual today, and see what you notice.

quote: Let nothing disturb you, let nothing frighten you. All things are passing.
intention: Whatever goes sideways today, whisper to yourself: this too is passing.

quote: We're all just walking each other home.
intention: Be gentle with the next person who annoys you. They're walking home too.

quote: Work is love made visible.
intention: Do one task today as if it were a gift for someone you love.

quote: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
intention: Choose one word for who you want to be today. Act from that word.

quote: You are the sky. Everything else is just the weather.
intention: When the mind gets stormy, remember: you are the sky, not the storm.

quote: Faith is taking the first step even when you don't see the whole staircase.
intention: Take the first step on something you've been putting off. Just the first.

quote: Let yourself be silently drawn by the strange pull of what you really love. It will not lead you astray.
intention: Spend ten minutes today on something you love, for no reason at all.

quote: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
intention: Write down one thing your future self would thank you for, and do a piece of it.

quote: In the beginner's mind there are many possibilities, but in the expert's there are few.
intention: Meet something familiar today as if for the first time.

quote: Be patient toward all that is unsolved in your heart and try to love the questions themselves.
intention: Hold one open question today without rushing to answer it.

quote: All shall be well, and all shall be well, and all manner of thing shall be well.
intention: Loosen your grip on one thing you've been trying to control.

quote: Not all of us can do great things. But we can do small things with great love.
intention: Do one small kind thing today that no one will know about.

quote: Keep your face always toward the sunshine, and shadows will fall behind you.
intention: Step outside for five minutes and let the light reach your face.

quote: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
intention: Slow is fine. Stopping is the only thing to avoid. Do your sit.

quote: Smile, breathe and go slowly.
intention: Three times today: stop, smile, and take one slow breath.

quote: Courage is the most important of all the virtues, because without courage, you can't practice any other virtue consistently.
intention: Say the honest thing today, and say it kindly.

quote: The river and its waves are one surf: where is the difference between the river and its waves?
intention: Feel yourself as part of something larger today: the breath, the day, the people around you.

quote: You can't cross the sea merely by standing and staring at the water.
intention: Less planning, one more stroke. Begin.

quote: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
intention: Sort today's worries into two piles: yours to act on, and not yours. Put the second pile down.

quote: Before enlightenment, chop wood, carry water. After enlightenment, chop wood, carry water.
intention: Find the sacred in one chore today. The dishes are also practice.

quote: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
intention: Instead of fixing someone else today, notice one thing to soften in yourself.

quote: Your pain is the breaking of the shell that encloses your understanding.
intention: If something hurts today, ask what it might be opening in you.

quote: Faith is the bird that feels the light and sings when the dawn is still dark.
intention: Thank the day in advance, before you know how it will go.

quote: Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
intention: Skip the debate in your head today. Do the good thing.

quote: You can't stop the waves, but you can learn to surf.
intention: When the day gets choppy, find your breath and ride it.

quote: Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.
intention: Keep one promise to yourself today, especially the inconvenient one.

quote: Your own Self-Realization is the greatest service you can render the world.
intention: Sit today not for yourself alone. A calmer you is a gift to everyone you meet.

quote: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
intention: Today's step can be tiny. It still counts.

quote: Pride is not the opposite of shame, but its source. True humility is the only antidote to shame.
by: Uncle Iroh, Avatar: The Last Airbender
intention: Admit one small mistake today, lightly. Notice how much lighter you feel.

quote: Live quietly in the moment and see the beauty of all before you. The future will take care of itself.
intention: When the mind races ahead today, bring it back to what's here.

quote: When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.
intention: Name one thing you can't change. Then name one way you could meet it differently.

quote: Better than a thousand hollow words is one word that brings peace.
intention: Speak a little less today, and let what you do say be kind.

quote: Tell me, what is it you plan to do with your one wild and precious life?
intention: Do one thing today that makes you feel alive, not just busy.

quote: As a solid rock is not shaken by the wind, so the wise are not moved by praise or blame.
intention: Do your best today, and let neither praise nor criticism move you much.

quote: Realize deeply that the present moment is all you have.
intention: Each time you check the time today, take one breath in the now.

quote: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
intention: When a worry shows up, ask: is this happening, or am I imagining it?

quote: Yoga is skill in action.
intention: Let your practice show up in how you do things today, not just on the cushion.

quote: What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
intention: Trust what's within you a little more than usual today.

quote: Life happens wherever you are, whether you make it or not.
by: Uncle Iroh, Avatar: The Last Airbender
intention: Stop waiting for life to start. It's already here. Join it.

quote: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
intention: Catch one unhelpful thought today and gently put it down.

quote: Wherever you are is the entry point.
intention: Don't wait for a better place to begin. Here will do.

quote: The mind is like a puppy. Don't beat it. Just bring it back.
intention: Each time you wander today, come back without scolding yourself.

quote: The breath has kept you alive all day without once asking for thanks. Thank it anyway.
intention: Before each meal today, take one grateful breath.

quote: Motivation comes and goes. Practice stays. Sit anyway.
intention: Don't wait to feel like it. Sit for five minutes and let the feeling catch up.
